evaluation_method: Randomized Controlled Trial with Four Arms
intervention_description: Multi-faceted economic inclusion program with three treatment packages (psychosocial, capital, and full) layered on existing national cash transfer program, aimed at improving income-generating activities and welfare for women beneficiaries

intervention_end.literal_text: intervention lasted until after the planting season

graduation_components_rationale.consumption_support: Monthly cash transfers from national program
graduation_components_rationale.assets: Lump-sum cash grant to promote investments
graduation_components_rationale.savings: Village Savings and Loans Association (VSLA) component
graduation_components_rationale.social_empowerment: Community sensitization and life skills training

outcomes.outcome_name: Daily household consumption per adult equivalent
outcomes.outcome_description: Total daily household consumption per adult equivalent in USD
outcomes.literal_text: Statistically significant treatment effects on household consumption for all three packages at both follow-ups

outcomes.outcome_description: Inverse Food Insecurity Experience Scale (FIES) with 12-month recall
outcomes.literal_text: Household food security improves by 0.21-0.66, a 6%-20% change relative to control
Dietary diversity improves by 2.71-6.01 points over 7 days, a 10%-22% improvement relative to control

outcomes.outcome_name: Business revenue from women's off-farm self-employment
outcomes.outcome_description: Monthly business revenue in USD for eligible women
outcomes.literal_text: Business revenues increase by $17-$36 per eligible woman per month, a 76%-160% increase relative to control

outcomes.outcome_description: Yearly agricultural harvest value in USD for eligible women
outcomes.literal_text: Substantial impacts on eligible women's revenues from agriculture in the 2nd follow-up for psychosocial and full packages

outcomes.outcome_description: Yearly wage earnings in USD for eligible women
outcomes.literal_text: Statistically significant treatment effects found for full package in 2nd follow-up

outcomes.outcome_description: Yearly livestock revenue in USD for eligible women
outcomes.literal_text: Impacts on eligible women's livestock revenues statistically significant in 1st follow-up for psychosocial package, in 2nd follow-up for capital and full packages

notes: Multi-country RCT in Sahel Adaptive Social Protection program, with Niger being the first implementation site
